ValidationRule.description: Use a registered member, a Business Account partner, positive points, and a valid ENE voucher code.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use a registered member, a Business Account partner, positive points, and a valid ENE voucher code.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Points_Spent__c <= 0, Value_CZK__c < 0, NOT(Member__r.IsPersonAccount), ISBLANK(Member__r.Member_Number__c), Partner__r.IsPersonAccount, NOT(REGEX(Code__c, "ENE-[ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{4}-[ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{4}")))
